response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM inventory AS i JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_average AS (SELECT AVG(rating_count) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts) SELECT SUM(rc.rating_count) AS total_count, AVG(rc.rating_count - ra.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM rating_counts AS rc CROSS JOIN rating_average AS ra WHERE rc.rating_count > ra.avg_count
